experiment: E97 locator_table: name the part each 67M fine-tune's gain runs through, or 'not found' at head and MLP grain, across the saved tasks
plan: reports/plans/2026-11-05_plan_e97-locator.md, with its 'From the E96 check' paragraph and the lead's two settled changes of 2026-11-05 (stage 2 on whole rows; natural-text means beside)
limit: a new circuit built from old parts still reads as reuse: finding a part says the behaviour runs through it, not that one old circuit is unchanged

definitions.part: one head's output (its 128-wide slice of o_proj's input, as E96) or one block's MLP output (down_proj's output); 24 heads and 4 MLPs, at every position
definitions.units: lo: log-odds of the target against every other token at the read position (identity.log_odds, E96's; the filed unit). gap: log p(target) - log p(the read's other form), E53's; beside, only on lowercase and the E53 cipher (F1 of the E96 check)
definitions.G: the state's mean over the site's reads minus W0's mean over the same reads, per unit
definitions.carry_A: the state with the part's output replaced by W0's output on the same inputs (W0's run, cached); share = (state - patched) / G. W0 is never moved
definitions.write_B: the state with one matrix's dW reverted (24), one head's rows of q, k, v and columns of o reverted (24), one block's c_fc and down_proj reverted (4), and all 24 reverted; share = (state - reverted) / G. sum_matrix is the non-additivity number
definitions.removal: the state with the part's output at W0's mean over the task's own inputs and positions (F3); own fall = state - state with the part off, in nats; share = own fall / G. W0's own fall (w0_move) beside, never subtracted. Beside: the same with E96's natural-text head means (results/means.pt of locate_mechanism)
definitions.sufficiency: W0 with the part's output taken from the state's run (Prakash et al. 2024's cross-model patch); share = rise / G; saved, no rule
definitions.capability: W0's second-copy top-1 on repeated random sequences (copying.induction, E62's settings) with the part at the copy windows' means; c_share = 1 - off / intact. Only the T5 rows have a capability read
definitions.probability: every probability printed or saved is the mean probability over the reads (F5), never the probability at the mean log-odds
definitions.standard_error: of the removal share, clustered by source row (F4); band = 2 x that
definitions.greedy_pair: E96's: the head of largest removal share, then the head that with it loses the largest share; read on every seed of the task and of its control

located_rule.rule: For a nominated part, on every seed: task own fall >= a * G_task, the same seed's control own fall <= control_max * G_control, and task own fall >= ratio * control own fall, in nats, unit lo. A part is located when every seed passes. Code: locator_rules.seed_reading, task_reading
located_rule.nominated: per state: the top nominate_top parts by carry, the top nominate_top heads by write, the block MLP of each MLP matrix in the top nominate_top by write, and the greedy pair; the union over the task's seeds (locator_rules.nominees)
located_rule.part_named: of the located parts, the one whose weakest seed's share is largest (locator_rules.best_located); none located: 'none at head/MLP grain', and the row's numbers are read at that seed's top carry part
located_rule.a_rule: the weakest copy seed's own-terms removal share at its top head by removal (singles, unit lo), truncated to two decimals (locator_rules.a_from), written to stage1.json before stage 2 reads it. nan or a <= 0 stops the job. E96's table suggests about 0.56 (on natural-text means)

edge_cases.a tie at the top of the carry map: no part named (the row reads 'the carry map's top is tied')
edge_cases.a not finite or <= 0: unreadable: no bar a; the job stops before stage 2

located_rule.do_nothing: Run on the do-nothing state before filing: W0 as the state has G = 0 exactly, so every seed reads 'unreadable: no gain' and nothing is located (tests/test_locator_rules.py::test_the_do_nothing_state_cannot_pass). The all-reverted read on every state is the same check in the job
located_rule.tests: tests/test_locator_rules.py: every edge case above, the plant check on an exact record, the inheritance floor, the hand write, the nominees

thresholds.control_max_source: E62's filed bar for a spared map (E96 predictions.json); a tie counts as spared
thresholds.ratio_source: the plan's filed located rule (Fable's E96 rule): task fall >= 2 x control fall in nats; a tie passes
thresholds.nominate_top_source: Fable's advice Q3: the top three by carry and by write
thresholds.reread_tol_source: E96 predictions_stage2.json reread_tol; the plants' reads are exact by construction (W0 + 0 is W0 on a deterministic path)
thresholds.zero_tol_source: E96 predictions_stage2.json zero_tol (E53's); all 24 reverted on every state
thresholds.plant_rel_tol_source: E90's write_rel_tol (new_vs_reuse predictions.json): the plant's G within 5% of copy-24 seed 0's G; status 'cap' keeps the largest alpha and is reported, not a miss (the plants' bars do not depend on the scale)

stage0.note: The plants: ctxpatch.write_state's write (perturb.key_write) into h.3.mlp.down_proj and h.1.mlp.down_proj, fitted on the 24-key copy table's train windows (open_pair/amend1/windows_copy_trained.pt, the 24 trained keys, E90's copy-24 site), read on its 75 held-out windows, scaled to copy-24 seed 0's G. The job stops on any miss
carry_on_every_part_upstream: +-1e-4; heads at blocks <= the edited block, MLPs below it
stage0.carry_downstream_of_the_block1_plant: measured, no bar: the inheritance floor
all_24_reverted_G: |G| <= 0.001, on every state of every stage (the job stops on a miss)
stage0.gains_reread: E62's six G within 0.02 of induction_cue/results/run.json; E53's four G on its 127-token windows within 0.02 of locate_mechanism/results/stage2_stage0.json G_fp32 (the same fp32 path); W0's whole-row gap within 0.02 of a0.json's lowercase 1.1776 and cipher -5.5330 (A0's bf16 read; the E96 check re-read 1.1772 under bf16)

stage1.copy_removal_band_source: E96's own-terms fall at (2,4) on natural-text means; reported, decides nothing (the means here are the task windows')
stage1.carry_top_on_copy: (2,4) on all three seeds: the control; else the miss branch and no stage 3
stage1.lookup_carry_lean: an MLP at block 0-2; share unfiled
stage1.write_top: unknown, no lean, on either map
stage1.hand_write: the block-3 plant's own-terms share with (2,4) off, on its own windows, at most the lookup's largest seed share at (2,4) (locator_rules.write_within); reported with whether it is under a
stage1.miss_branch: carry misses (2,4) on copy: the carry map reads propagation, not mechanism; fall back to the write map with a direct-effect read in the one amendment

stage2.site: whole val rows 0-255 at every scored position, A0's read (the E96 check's F2), fp32; E53's 127-token windows beside, removal only
stage2.lowercase_lean: not found by the located rule at head grain: E96 read at most 0.39 of 1.67 for any head on the windows; the E96 check read 0.33 at most on whole rows, seed 0
stage2.new_information: whether carry and write put the gain in block MLPs, and whether the top carry part clears the inheritance floor
stage2.inheritance_branch: if the block-1 plant's largest carry share downstream exceeds the smallest carry share among the top nominate_top carry parts of either lowercase seed, this grain cannot nominate on lowercase: its rows read that, not located

stage3.runs_if: stage 0 passed and stage 1's control passed
stage3.pairs: rank-1, half-known (elicit) and copy-24 against the 24-key cipher, the cipher against rank-1, all seeds 0-2; ident32 against rand32 and back, seeds 0-1
stage3.beside_only: emoticon and two ladder rungs (r1_t534_v369, r2_t359_v816), seeds 0-1, against their same-windows null (recruitment_test states *_null.pt): verdict 'does not apply' (decisions.md line 121), the state's and the null's own falls in nats beside
stage3.emoticon_vpd_source: VPD's paper's emoticon subcomponent h.2.mlp.down_proj:2359; beside only: if the write map's top matrix differs, say so; VPD does not choose the part

tree.a plant reads wrong in stage 0: a code bug: fix and rerun, no reading
tree.stages 0-1 pass, lowercase has no locate: report 'not found at head or MLP grain' with where carry and write put the gain; stage 3 runs
tree.inheritance exceeds the smallest nominat: this grain cannot nominate there; report it, that row stops
tree.stage 3 locates parts on few tasks: the table says so; rows stay unreadable with the reason
tree.labels wanted on constant-answer tasks: a decision card, not an amendment

settings.natural_means: experiments/locate_mechanism/results/means.pt: W0's head means on 41-token natural Pile spans (E96 stage 1); heads only, no MLP means exist there
settings.precision: target model fp32, allow_tf32 off, as E96
settings.batch: 16,384 tokens per forward (32 whole rows, 129 windows of 127, 399 of 41)
settings.states: experiments/locator_table/sites.py TASKS; every file checked against the sha256 its experiment saved (E90's records, E53's finetune.json, recruitment_test stage0.json)
settings.table: results/table.json .table[]: one row per (task, seed); E90's fields task, C (copied from E90's stage2.json by its task name), share, control_share, band, verdict, reason, plus part, a_share, b_share, c_share, w0_move, located; beside: read_at, fall_nats, control_fall_nats, share_gap_unit, share_natural_means, p_mean_off, G, G_control, p_mean, p_mean_w0, control_task, stage. verdict empty for baseline-lead except 'does not apply' on constant-answer rows
